blocks.text: The next time you view a condominium, plan to stay for dinner. Pick up a few groceries, find somewhere you would eat after a busy workday and take the route back to the property. Those extra hours can help answer a question that matters long after the viewing: can you picture this becoming your routine? Your home life extends beyond your front door. Where you live influences how easily you can meet a friend after work or fit an errand into your day. Spending time in the neighborhood helps you see how an address could work for you.
